# Preserved upstream notices

The two license files here are unchanged copies of the supplied pseudo-Hamiltonian neural-network repository's root `LICENSE` and nested `phlearn/LICENSE.txt`. Their notices differ, so both are preserved: the root notice names SINTEF in 2025; the nested notice contains the original bracketed 2022 SINTEF Digital wording.

Source repository: [SINTEF/pseudo-hamiltonian-neural-networks](https://github.com/SINTEF/pseudo-hamiltonian-neural-networks). The inspected local source was `Existing codebases/pseudo-hamiltonian-neural-networks-main` in the private comparison workspace. Exact source-license hashes are recorded in `docs/source-provenance.json`.

These notices cover their respective upstream material. The project owner has separately authorized use of all four underlying codebases in the MIT-licensed `phsi` release; see `docs/license-status.md`. No upstream source repository, literature document, dataset or trained model is bundled here.
